settings.content: Colors and font for every Lucky section. The defaults are the approved design; change one and the whole site follows.

settings.label: Google Font family
settings.info: Any family name from fonts.google.com. Archivo is the approved font.

settings.content: The bag drawer and the cart page. Rewards show as flags on the progress bar; the free-shipping flag uses the threshold under Lucky brand.

A gift drops into the bag when the tier is reached and comes out if they drop below. To make it ring up at $0 it also needs an automatic discount in Discounts (Buy X get Y or amount off that product). Ask the chat to set it up.

settings.label: Tier 1: line after the amount
settings.default: more and a hat's on us.

settings.label: Tier 2: line after the amount
settings.default: more and a polo's on us.

settings.label: Free shipping: line after the amount
Fallback collection
settings.info: Shown when a product has no complementary products set in the Search & Discovery app. Empty = Gear.

settings.label: Trust line
settings.default: Sixty days to try any club.

settings.label: Show "or 4 payments" line
settings.info: Only turn on if Shop Pay Installments is on for the store.

settings.label: Savings line
settings.info: {amount} becomes the dollar amount. For a promo, e.g. "Black Friday savings: {amount}".

settings.label: Show a banner at the top of the bag and cart
Banner text
settings.default: Black Friday: 20% off polos, taken off in the bag.

settings.label: Shop Pay / Apple Pay / Google Pay buttons in the bag
settings.info: Faster checkout, but those buttons skip Loop's free-returns offer. Leave off unless you'd rather have speed.

settings.content: Shows the real Shopify count ("Only 3 left") in the bag, the cart and next to the price on product pages, only when a variant is at or under the number below and stops selling at zero.

settings.label: Tag
settings.info: Add this tag to a product in Shopify to include it.
